Our Story

Where Art
Meets Appetite

Tucked on Avinashi Road in the heart of Peelamedu, ZOCA Café is Coimbatore's most vibrant dining experience. Floor-to-ceiling murals, hand-painted graffiti art, petal-shaped lamps, and floral archways create a space unlike anything else in the city.

We serve a bold multicuisine menu — from buttery North Indian gravies and smoky tandoori to handcrafted pasta, crispy momos, continental platters, and signature milkshakes. Every plate is crafted to be as beautiful as our walls.
